title: robis: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS) Client
description:
robis is an R package for accessing data from the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS) directly from R. OBIS is a global open-access data and information clearing-house on marine biodiversity for science, conservation and sustainable development.

With robis, users can download species occurrence data from OBIS, create checklists of taxa that meet a set of filters, download measurements and facts associated with occurrences, and create maps of occurrences, including interactive leaflet maps.

robis is available from CRAN, with documentation at iobis.github.io/robis. This archive contains the package source code from github.com/iobis/robis.
